title: About EVE Onion
content:
EVE Onion is New Eden's premier source for satirical news coverage of the EVE Online universe.

Like The Onion, but for internet spaceships.

Founded in 2018, EVE Onion brings you the serious journalism you'd expect from a galactic news network - except none of it's real. From CCP's latest unimplemented features to the completely fictional drama between player factions, we cover the stories that matter to capsuleers everywhere.

Our Mission: To provide quality satirical content that keeps the EVE Online community laughing, even when their Titan just got blobbed by a coalition 10x their size.

Contact: Tips? Slap us on social media.
